name: Jong Shyn Shipbuilding Co., Ltd.
summary: Jong Shyn Shipbuilding Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, wholesale, and repair of ships and its parts in Taiwan and internationally. It operates through Shipbuilding and Repair; and Other Department segments. The company offers freighters, frigates, tugboats, shuttle boats, fishing boats, ferries, yachts, oil tankers, research vessels, land-based engineering equipment, and special ships, as well as patrol ships, lifeguard boats, passenger ships, chemical tankers, and ultra-low temperature fridge vessels.
